BaseSiteSettingsRoute > initialize() > throws when the ObjectFactory was never injected
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > initialize() > does not recreate repoUtils if it's already set
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uninitialized repoUtils guards > getSettings() throws INTERNAL_ERROR when repoUtils is unset
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uninitialized repoUtils guards > updateSettings() throws INTERNAL_ERROR when repoUtils is unset
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > getSettings / getOrCreate > creates the default row (all fields unset) on first access
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > getSettings / getOrCreate > returns the existing row without creating one when it's already present
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > getSettings / getOrCreate > recovers from a concurrent-create race by re-fetching the now-existing row
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > getSettings / getOrCreate > re-throws a create failure that isn't a recoverable identifier collision
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > getSettings / getOrCreate > re-throws IDENTIFIER_EXISTS when the recovery re-fetch also comes back empty
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > updateSettings > leaves omitted fields untouched and clears an explicit null
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > updateSettings > sets every provided field
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadLogo > stores base64-encoded bytes and the normalized content type
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadLogo > normalizes an array content-type header value and strips charset params
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadLogo > rejects a missing content-type
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadLogo > rejects an unsupported content-type
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadLogo > rejects a non-Buffer body
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadLogo > rejects an empty body
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadLogo > rejects an oversized body
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > deleteLogo > clears the uploaded logo fields
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > getLogo > streams the exact decoded bytes with the stored content type
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > getLogo > 404s when no logo has been uploaded
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadStylesheet > stores the raw CSS text from a string body
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadStylesheet > stores the raw CSS text from a Buffer body
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadStylesheet > rejects a body of an unsupported type

BaseSiteSettingsRoute > uploadStylesheet > rejects an oversized body
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > deleteStylesheet > clears the uploaded stylesheet field
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > getStylesheet > streams the exact stored CSS text with a text/css content type
BaseSiteSettingsRoute > getStylesheet > 404s when no stylesheet has been uploaded
